text:
[issue by evhub]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

The crash occurs when tabbing out and then back in to Minecraft while the inventory is open.

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

I'm using `jei-1.21.1-neoforge-19.27.0.336`. I am somewhat suspicious that the crash could be coming from [JustEnoughMekanismMultiblocks](https://github.com/gisellevonbingen-Minecraft/JustEnoughMekanismMultiblocks) (of which I am using `JustEnoughMekanismMultiblocks-1.21.1-7.12`) rather than JEI itself, since there's a mixin from it in the crash report, so feel free to redirect me there.

### Crash Report

https://bytebin.lucko.me/QWclO0qTX2

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!
This is probably caused by the mixin or a very weird screen, but I may be able to work around it.

[comment by mezz (owner)]
This should be fixed in the most recent version of JEI for 1.21.1, please let me know if you run into more issues.
